source.name: Colorado ECMC, Wells (API spots) map service

at_risk.definition: ECMC status SI (shut in) or TA (temporarily abandoned), with an operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked yet. All 1,302 USGS Colorado wells (from ECMC's Orphan Well Program) match by API number.
notes: Status codes: PR producing, AC active, IJ injecting, SI shut in, TA temporarily abandoned, PA plugged and abandoned, AL abandoned location, AP approved permit, EP expired permit. API is county + well; prefix 05 is added.
